audit_event_actor_is_identified.name: audit_event_actor_is_identified
audit_event_actor_is_identified.value: ("actor_type" = 'user' and "actor_id" is not null and "actor_id" ~ '^usr_[0-9a-z]{16}$') or ("actor_type" = 'system' and "actor_id" is null)

audit_event_on_behalf_of_is_identified.name: audit_event_on_behalf_of_is_identified
audit_event_on_behalf_of_is_identified.value: ("on_behalf_of_id" is not null and "on_behalf_of_id" ~ '^usr_[0-9a-z]{16}$') or ("on_behalf_of_id" is null and "on_behalf_of_label" is null)

evidence_attestation_complete.name: evidence_attestation_complete
evidence_attestation_complete.value:
(
        "attested_at" is null
          and "attested_by_id" is null
          and "attested_by_label" is null
      ) or (
        "attested_at" is not null
          and "attested_by_id" is not null
          and "attested_by_id" ~ '^usr_[0-9a-z]{16}$'
      )
